observations.why: Imperative command to erase knowledge asserts control over what the recipient may know — coercive in its demand, informational in its target being the facts themselves.
Direct imperative to strip knowledge from the recipient's scope, same coercive-informational pattern as src-1: authority claimed by commanding what facts may be retained.

mints.name: MandateToForget
mints.title: command to erase or remove knowledge from the recipient's scope
mints.frame: Is authority here being asserted by ordering the erasure or suppression of facts, rather than by offering reasons to disregard them?
